question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Full query: group by rating category
WITH first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_date,
        p.rental_id,
        p.amount,
        r.inventory_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date) AS rn
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
),
customer_first_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        inventory_id,
        payment_date
    FROM first_rental
    WHERE rn = 1
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
customer_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cfm.customer_id,
        f.rating,
        ct.total_amount,
        ct.total_rentals - 1 AS subsequent_rentals
    FROM customer_first_movie cfm
    JOIN inventory i ON cfm.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN customer_totals ct ON cfm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    rating,
    ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(subsequent_rentals), 2) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_data
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating;
